claims.value: Bodart: side A 7,000 under Victor; side B 4,500 and 141 guns under Courbière.
claims.rationale: Read on the registered page image. His general rule is forces disposable for the engagement, rounded upward (shared research-conventions index); a stated siege endpoint or engaged subset takes precedence over treating it as an opening count. Population/timing alternatives are not reconciled. English rendering (ours): "The Prussian garrison, 4,500 with 141 guns under General of Infantry L’Homme de Courbière, successfully defends and holds against Victor’s French blockade and siege corps of 7,000 until the Peace of Tilsit; Graudenz did not fall into enemy hands."

claims.value: Höpfner estimates about 4,500 garrison troops after discussing incomplete nominal battalions; this is not an inspected dated full return.
claims.rationale: Retrospective estimate with an uncertain establishment basis, not an inspected dated full return. English rendering (ours): "All in all one may therefore probably assume 4,500 men for the garrison"

citations.quote: Alles in Allem dürfte man daher wohl 4500 Mann zur Besatzung annehmen

claims.value: Höpfner places eleven allied battalions, almost 7,000 men, before the fortress at the beginning of June.
claims.rationale: Late besieging force, not the opening January blockade population; mediated French allied total. English rendering (ours): "eleven battalions, almost 7,000 men strong, stood before the fortress at the beginning of June."

citations.quote: 11 Bataill. in der Stärke von beinahe 7000 Mann mit Anfang Juni vor der Festung standen.

claims.value: Courbière was governor, Schramm commandant, Borell du Bernay vice-commandant and Streckenbach acting engineering officer.
claims.rationale: English rendering (ours): "Governor of Graudenz was the 73-year-old infantry general L’Homme de Courbiere" English rendering (ours): "Commandant was the 65-year-old artillery colonel Schramm and vice-commandant the 70-year-old Lieutenant-Colonel Borell du Bernay"

citations.quote: Gouverneur von Graudenz war der 73jährige General der Infanterie L’Homme de Courbiere
Kommandant wurde der 65jährige Artillerie-Oberst Schramm und Vice-Kommandant der 70jährige Oberstlieutenant Borell du Bernay

claims.value: Victor received command of the besieging troops after Danzig fell; d’Anthouard directed siege artillery and Aymé siege works.
claims.rationale: Earlier blockade authority differs: p 719 describes Rouyer under Napoleon’s order to Bernadotte; Victor is not projected backwards across the whole date span. English rendering (ours): "General Victor was assigned command of the besieging troops" English rendering (ours): "Colonel Aymé was to direct the siege works and received 490 engineering troops." English rendering of earlier order (ours): "On 4 January, while arranging winter quarters in South and East Prussia from Warsaw, Napoleon ordered Bernadotte that Division-General Rouyer should go to Bromberg, take command of the Hesse-Darmstadt troops and carry out the Graudenz blockade jointly with the 1st Corps division then in Thorn."

citations.quote: Dem General Victor wurde das Kommando der Belagerungstruppen übertragen
Der Oberst Aymé sollte die Belagerungsarbeiten leiten und erhielt 490 Mann Genietruppen zugewiesen.

Am 4. Januar, als Napoleon von Warschau aus die Winterquartiere seiner Armee in Süd- und Ostpreußen ordnete, befahl er dem M. Bernadotte: der Divisions-General Rouyer solle nach Bromberg gehen, das Kommando der Hessen-Darmstädter übernehmen, mit der augenblicklich in Thorn anwesenden Division des 1. Korps gemeinschaftlich die Blokade von Graudenz bewerkstelligen

claims.value: Höpfner gives 152 fortress defence pieces plus a separate field-gun inventory of uncertain disposition, against Bodart’s 141.
claims.rationale: Inventory populations/dates unresolved; preserve alternative, do not normalize to one total. English rendering (ours): "Altogether the fortress thus possessed for defence 109 cannon and 43 throwing pieces, or 152 guns."

citations.quote: Im Ganzen besaß die Festung somit zur Defension 109 Kanonen und 43 Wurfgeschütze oder 152 Geschütze.

claims.value: Höpfner says a printed order announcing Danzig’s capitulation reached Prussian posts on 28 May and was withheld from the garrison.
claims.rationale: A claim about transmission, not a measured morale effect. English rendering (ours): "The news was concealed from the garrison."

citations.quote: Der Besatzung wurde die Nachricht verschwiegen.

claims.value: After Danzig fell Napoleon moved to a serious siege of Graudenz.
claims.rationale: English rendering (ours): "As soon as Danzig had fallen, Napoleon had seriously contemplated the siege of Graudenz."

citations.quote: Sobald Danzig gefallen war, hatte Napoleon ernsthaft an die Belagerung von Graudenz gedacht.
